system.description:
Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes meditating to seek visions of the future. At that time, you can spend a Force Point as a part of this meditation.

Once during the rest of the day, whenever you or a Vehicle you Pilot are the target of an attack, you can choose to negate that attack provided the attack roll is not a Natural 20. At the end of the day, if you did not use this ability, you regain the Force Point spent on the meditation.
